description: This file defines the interface for the AOM codec library, including enums, structs, macros, and function prototypes related to video codec operations, error handling, capabilities, and control mechanisms.

methods.name: aom_codec_version
methods.description: Returns the packed integer representing the library version.

methods.name: aom_codec_version_str
methods.description: Returns a string with the full library version.

methods.name: aom_codec_version_extra_str
methods.description: Returns an extra string component of the version.

methods.name: aom_codec_build_config
methods.description: Returns a string with build configuration details.

methods.name: aom_codec_iface_name
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for a codec interface.

methods.name: aom_codec_err_to_string
methods.description: Converts an error code to a human-readable string.

methods.name: aom_codec_error
methods.description: Returns a string describing the last error in a codec context.

methods.name: aom_codec_error_detail
methods.description: Returns detailed error info for a codec context.

methods.name: aom_codec_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a codec context, freeing resources.

methods.name: aom_codec_get_caps
methods.description: Retrieves capabilities bitfield of a codec interface.

methods.name: aom_codec_control_
methods.description: Controls codec parameters via control IDs.
